necessity_paragraph: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and presyncope in the setting of known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0) and unspecified cardiac arrhythmia (I49.9). Due to the intermittent nature of these symptoms, long-term continuous ECG monitoring (CPT 93247) is indicated to evaluate for potential arrhythmic causes of collapse. This service is necessary to correlate clinical events with underlying rhythm disturbances as described in the clinical indication note.
